aboutSection.title: The Lady's Rental Story
aboutSection.headline: Where Fairy Garden Whimsy Meets Luxury Fashion
aboutSection.story: Founded in the heart of Manila and Bonifacio Global City, Lady's Rental believes every woman deserves to experience the magic of couture fashion without purchasing gowns worn only once. Our wardrobe contains individually curated designer pieces, each professionally sanitised, steamed, and fitted for your special moment.

steps.title: Choose Your Dress & Dates

faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know about renting with Lady's Rental.

items.question: How long is the standard rental period?
items.answer: Our standard rental duration is 3 days. Day 1 is your delivery or pickup day, Day 2 is your special event day, and Day 3 is your return day. Need extra time? Additional days can be added for a small daily fee.

items.question: How does payment verification work?
items.answer: After completing your booking form, transfer your rental fee and refundable security deposit via GCash, Maya, or BDO/BPI Bank Transfer, then upload your payment screenshot. Our administrator will verify the amount and issue an official PDF receipt.

items.question: How do the Loyalty Rewards work?
items.answer: Every completed and returned dress rental earns 1 heart stamp on your digital loyalty card. At 5 completed rentals, you unlock 50% OFF your next rental. At 10 completed rentals, you earn ONE FREE 3-DAY DRESS RENTAL!

items.question: What is your cleaning and damage policy?
items.answer: Do not attempt to wash or dry-clean the dress yourself! Every rental includes complimentary standard eco-sanitization. Light wrinkles steam out easily, and minor wear is covered.

policies.cancellationPolicy: Full refund if cancelled at least 7 days before rental start date. 50% refund if cancelled 3-6 days prior. Non-refundable within 48 hours.
